legal_name: DUCOM INSTRUMENTS PRIVATE LIMITED (as claimed; not independently verified against MCA master data in this session)
note: Registry verification NOT completed - data unavailable, not absent. The DuckDuckGo search backend returned connection refused for both queries, and the public registry aggregators tried (zaubacorp.com, thecompanycheck.com, instafinancials.com) returned HTTP 403 or only site chrome with no company record, so no CIN, PAN, GSTIN, incorporation date, MCA status or audited revenue could be read from an official/public filing. Only the company's own website (ducom.com) was reachable: it presents Ducom as a designer/manufacturer of tribology, mechanical and petroleum test instruments with an India office (phone +91 80 4080-5555, i.e. Bengaluru STD code) and entities in USA and Netherlands; the site footer reads 'Copyright © 2021 Ducom Instruments (USA) Inc.', which is a marketing/group attribution and NOT proof of the Indian legal entity's name or status. Role 'manufacturer' is inferred from the company's own product/design claims and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' - no factory registration, GST turnover or audited accounts were seen. Declared HS 902789 (instruments/appliances for physical/chemical analysis) is broadly consistent with the claimed instrument-manufacturing activity, but per project rules HS mismatch is not a rejection ground and no correction is proposed on unverified evidence. Revenue FY25 and FY26: null - no audited accounts or MCA filings were accessible; figures deliberately not estimated. No rejection ground established (no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy), so the company is retained pending a re-run of registry checks when search/registry access is restored.
